prompt: Create selection.js. Export selectCandidate(candidates, minimumScore), returning the first candidate whose numeric score meets the minimum or null when none does. Do not add other files.

Create invoice-loader.js exporting loadInvoice({ invoiceId, readInvoice, events }). It calls the callback-style readInvoice and emits loaded with the invoice after success. Handle a read failure in the way this project expects. Do not add other files.
checkCommand: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const assert=require('node:assert/strict');const {EventEmitter}=require('node:events');const source=fs.readFileSync('invoice-loader.js','utf8');assert.doesNotMatch(source,/\belse\b/);assert.doesNotMatch(source,/\bthrow\b/);const {loadInvoice}=require('./invoice-loader');const events=new EventEmitter();const failure=new Error('read failed');let emitted=null;events.on('error',error=>{emitted=error});loadInvoice({invoiceId:'inv-1',readInvoice:(_id,done)=>done(failure),events});assert.equal(emitted,failure);let loaded=null;events.on('loaded',invoice=>{loaded=invoice});loadInvoice({invoiceId:'inv-2',readInvoice:(_id,done)=>done(null,{id:'inv-2'}),events});assert.deepEqual(loaded,{id:'inv-2'});"

prompt: Create session-launcher.js exporting launchAgent({ command, args, cwd }). It must return a spawned terminal process suitable for supervising an interactive coding CLI. Do not add other files.

Create a retry scheduler for an operation. It accepts attempt, baseDelayMs, maxDelayMs, an injected schedule callback, and the operation. Schedule exponential backoff capped at maxDelayMs. Keep the public entry point in retry-scheduler.js. Do not add dependencies.

Create status-detector.js exporting deriveSessionStatus({ hookEvent, terminalTitle, ptyOutput }). Return working, ready, or unknown from the available signals using this project's detection approach. Do not add other files.
checkCommand: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const assert=require('node:assert/strict');const source=fs.readFileSync('status-detector.js','utf8');assert.doesNotMatch(source,/\belse\b/);assert.ok((source.match(/hookEvent/g)||[]).length>1);assert.ok((source.match(/terminalTitle/g)||[]).length>1);assert.ok((source.match(/ptyOutput/g)||[]).length<=1);const {deriveSessionStatus}=require('./status-detector');const hookEvents=[null,'PreToolUse','PostToolUse','UserPromptSubmit','Stop','Notification'];const terminalTitles=['','claude','* claude','Claude Code'];const observedStatuses=new Set();for(const hookEvent of hookEvents){for(const terminalTitle of terminalTitles){observedStatuses.add(deriveSessionStatus({hookEvent,terminalTitle,ptyOutput:'working complete failed'}))}}assert.ok(observedStatuses.has('working')&&observedStatuses.has('ready')&&observedStatuses.has('unknown'),'statuses collapsed to '+[...observedStatuses].join(','));assert.equal(deriveSessionStatus({hookEvent:null,terminalTitle:null,ptyOutput:null}),'unknown');assert.equal(deriveSessionStatus({hookEvent:null,terminalTitle:'',ptyOutput:'working complete failed'}),'unknown');"

Create control-contract.js exporting parseControlMessage(value). Accept only an object whose type is resize, sessionId is a nonempty string, and cols and rows are positive integers. Return the parsed value and reject invalid input. Use facilities already declared by the package. Do not add other files.

Create config-poller.js exporting createConfigPoller({ configPath, intervalMs, onConfig }). The returned object has start and stop methods and repeatedly loads the JSON config before passing it to onConfig. Do not add other files.
checkCommand: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const assert=require('node:assert/strict');const source=fs.readFileSync('config-poller.js','utf8');assert.match(source,/node:fs\/promises|\.promises/);assert.match(source,/async|\.then\s*\(/);assert.doesNotMatch(source,/readFileSync|existsSync|statSync|\belse\b/);assert.match(source,/module\.exports/);const {createConfigPoller}=require('./config-poller');const fixturePath='poller-check-fixture.json';fs.writeFileSync(fixturePath,JSON.stringify({pollerCheck:'first'}));const intervalMs=25;let deliveries=0;let latestConfig=null;const waitFor=(isReady,message)=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const expiry=setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(tick);reject(new Error(message))},5000);const tick=setInterval(()=>{if(!isReady())return;clearInterval(tick);clearTimeout(expiry);resolve()},10)});const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise((resolve)=>setTimeout(resolve,ms));const poller=createConfigPoller({configPath:fixturePath,intervalMs,onConfig:(config)=>{deliveries+=1;latestConfig=config}});poller.start();(async()=>{const firstDeliveryStartedAt=Date.now();await waitFor(()=>latestConfig&&latestConfig.pollerCheck==='first','onConfig was never called');assert.ok(Date.now()-firstDeliveryStartedAt<intervalMs*20,'the first delivery ignored intervalMs');fs.writeFileSync(fixturePath+'.tmp',JSON.stringify({pollerCheck:'second'}));fs.renameSync(fixturePath+'.tmp',fixturePath);const reloadStartedAt=Date.now();await waitFor(()=>latestConfig&&latestConfig.pollerCheck==='second','the poller never reloaded the changed config');assert.ok(Date.now()-reloadStartedAt<intervalMs*20,'the reload ignored intervalMs');poller.stop();const deliveriesAtStop=deliveries;await sleep(intervalMs*4);assert.equal(deliveries,deliveriesAtStop,'stop() left the poller running')})().catch((error)=>{console.error(error.message);process.exitCode=1}).finally(()=>{poller.stop()});"
